description: This Swift source file defines an enumeration 'OpenClawKitResources' that manages locating and providing access to a resource bundle for the OpenClawKit project. It includes logic to locate the resource bundle in various environments such as packaged applications, development/testing with SwiftPM, and provides fallback strategies to prevent fatal errors when resources are not found.

classes.name: BundleLocator
classes.description: A helper class used solely for type-based bundle lookup via 'Bundle(for:)'.

methods.name: locateBundle
methods.description: Determines the appropriate resource bundle by checking various locations in order and returning the first valid bundle found.

methods.name: loadModuleBundleSafely
methods.description: Attempts to locate the module's resource bundle without causing a fatal error, checking several candidate URLs and directory structures.
